# Public source-format samples

Captured on 2026-11-25 in GitHub Actions live smoke run 45646776408. ISTAT is a minimal public iCalendar excerpt; INPS and Banca d’Italia are reduced HTML fragments retaining observed public fields; MLPS is an extracted PDF text line.
